niphal.sense_hint: simple (this root has no attested qal; niphal serves as its basic/citation stem)

notes: Requested Qal ("be sick; be incurable") excluded: zero attested verb-morph forms anywhere in the corpus. The word's only other occurrences (Isa.17.11, Jer.15.18/17.9/17.16/30.12/30.15, Job.34.6, Mic.1.9) are the adjective אָנוּשׁ/אֲנוּשָׁה ("incurable"), tagged morph="HAamsa"/"HAafsa" -- a different part of speech from this verb, not a Qal citation. Only the Niphal wayyiqtol at 2Sam.12.15 is a genuine verb attestation.
